description.narrative: The project will help transform two national parks in Khuvsgul and Khentii aimags (provinces) as models for economically inclusive tourism and conservation in the protected area network, by improving park infrastructure, sanitation, and capacity to manage tourism growth sustainably. The designs emphasize tourism benefits for communities, protection of natural capital, and climate-resilient facilities; and scale up from previous grant projects in each park.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3787: 57% of contracts awarded and 1% disbursed as of 16 Jul 2025
Loan 3788: 95% of contracts awarded and 83% disbursed as of 16 Jul 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: Loan inception mission conducted on 4-7 September 2019. Special consultation mission for opening ceremonies conducted 3-11 October 2019. December 2019 - January 2020. Annual review mission was conducted on 20-24 September 2021. Special project administration mission was fielded to accelerate the project implementation on 14-16 June 2022. Project review mission was held in February 2023. Procurement plan were updated and version 7 was approved on 27 March 2023. Project fielded review mission on 1925 August and 17-22 September 2023.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jun 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/50013/50013-002-apfs-en_2.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Feb 2019: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/50013/50013-002-iee-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Jan 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/50013/50013-002-smr-en_5.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: The eco-certification pilot program was developed by consultant team and finalized with inputs from community representatives, and the eco-certification package is in accordance with the schedule at 80% implementation piloting 4 tour camps from KLNP and 1 tour camp from OBNP. Tourism vocation skills trainings were organized in Dadal and Khatgal reaching to over 800 local people (70% women) during May September 2023. A tourism council was revived with new community members at KLNP in July 2023, and consultations are on-going to establish a tourism council at OBNP. Construction of 37.9km road and car parks, the price increases of road construction materials and fuels caused the financial issues for the contractor and delayed the implementation with an overall physical progress of 51% having earth works completed but pending delay of surfacing the asphalt cover.The detailed engineering design of CKTC visitor center is to be finalized within October and approved by the CDC within Q4 2023. The construction of landfill facilities completed the civil works for Khatgal and Dadal landfills and is scheduled for final assessment of technical expertise commission and rehabilitation by October 2023. Weighbridges are 100% completed with procurement, installation, calibration of software in Dadal, Khatgal and Khankh. The construction of wastewater treatment facilities completed the civil works and construction for Khatgal WWT and is scheduled for technical expertise assessment by October 2023. The construction of Landfill in Khankh is at 60%, and the construction of WWTP in Khankh is at 28% implementation. Waste management plans for Dadal, Khatgal and Khankh soums were developed in July 2023 and carried out consultations with local stakeholders and are planned to be finalized within Q4 2023.
